summary: Wrote a ten-phase implementation plan at specs/797_shift_finite_type_eventually_periodic_worlds/plans/01_shift-finite-type-periodic-worlds.md, integrating the research report's measured axiom accounting and the prior cycle's user decision (ship BOTH the carrier-as-data choice-free theorem and the untouched [Finite W] version). The plan carries a Lean Challenge Statements block whose 16 declared identifiers cross-validate exactly against its Goals list, verified by replicating lean-challenge-snapshot.sh's own extractors. Two plan-time divergences from the research recommendations are recorded in issues.jsonl: probe relocation into the task directory is dropped (check-evidence-probes.sh forbids task-directory probes), and deliverables (2) and (3) land under Metalogic/Decidability/ rather than Semantics/ because no Semantics module may import Metalogic and the choice-free pigeonhole to be reused lives there.
